exclusions: Any source item outside the frozen UTC window
External web research or introduction of evidence not already stored in the repository
Final truth assessment, source reliability scoring, report narrative, or targeting-enabling detail
Treating commentary, repetition, or shared upstream material as independent evidence
definition_of_done: Every assigned source item was reviewed against its stored source-item record and raw manifest
Each material attributable assertion supportable from frozen repository evidence was represented as an atomic draft observation, or the omission reason was recorded as a coverage gap
Speaker attribution, qualifiers, day-level publication precision, upstream lineage, excerpts, and locators were preserved
No observation was promoted beyond draft and no claim or assessment was created
A queue proposal receipt was persisted; an empty proposals array is acceptable because the downstream graph is pre-materialized
Two separate self-review rounds passed and a receipt was persisted

result.summary: Created four atomic draft observations from the four assigned Dva Majors and Rybar source items while preserving channel attribution, Russian-language excerpts, day-level publication bounds, preview times, unresolved upstream lineage, and safety withholding.
coverage_gaps: Telegram previews did not expose timezone-bearing publication timestamps; source-item day precision and preview times were preserved without inventing exact UTC publication times.
The Rybar 82198 manifest states in editorial summary that actual damage required assessment, but no original excerpt or artifact supports a separate observation for that caveat.
Named upstream Reuters, Kotsnews, Russian Ministry of Defence, Rutube, and Soloviev Live materials were not registered in this shard and were not treated as independent evidence.
Granular frontline positions, active-unit movements, routes, map geometry, and other targeting-enabling details were automatically withheld.
